nsfwjs 4.4.0 by Infinite Red (https://github.com/infinitered/nsfwjs), MIT
licensed, bundling TensorFlow.js (Apache 2.0). The model is its
MobileNetV2Mid classifier (files model.min.js and group1-shard*.min.js).

Hooky's Live screen runs it in the browser on the OTHER person's video to
blur, and in clear cases end, explicit video. Frames never leave the phone.

The smaller MobileNetV2 model was tried first and dropped: it scored an
ordinary strapless-top selfie 0.86 "porn". This one scored it 0.14.
